title: Per-area table of a map (type, tax, unit fit) and its display settings
description: Field reference: DATA_SCHEMA.md. Checked whenever the game loads the file (mods included).

about.description: Free text for people reading the file.

fit.description: Radius (map units) of the largest circle around the army anchor inside the area; with display unitFitRadius it scales the area's units down.

display.description: Display settings of a mesh map: zoom limit, unit fitting, zoomed out markers.

maxZoom.description: The largest camera zoom (the classic maps: 1).

unitFitRadius.description: An area whose fit radius is below this scales its units by fit / unitFitRadius.

markerZoom.description: Below this on-screen unit scale (zoom x unit scale) armies show as a flag of constant size and buildings are left out.

flags.description: all: a flag in every owned area (classic); armies: only where units or a building stand.
